text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Filming a TV show at a rented cafe! My 
interview partner is Sweep Tosho! Wait, 
why are you picking a fight with me 
already?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shall claim an explosive 1st place in 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup and prove that 
I am a true princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer seems to be acting awfully 
secretive... Did you just hide a bag or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
C-Could this be... the present I was 
promised if I won the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup...! Nngh~! Princess☆Bomber, here I 
come~~!!
